facts.business: Advance Lifestyles Limited is engaged in real estate and textile sectors, and is exploring opportunities in mining and trading of bullion, precious metals, and allied activities.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company is contemplating in purchasing a running unit or setting up a textile unit.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpt
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (a) Unsecured interest-free loans of ₹3,51,189.88 Thousands and outstanding liabilities of ₹75,899.55 Thousands to parties under CIRP/non-traceable with no interest recognized; (b) Outstanding balances of ₹75,899.55 Thousands subject to confirmations/reconciliations not provided; (c) Interest-free loans granted in contravention of Section 186(7) of Companies Act, 2013 without assessment of financial impact under Ind AS 109.

key_risks: Real estate market at saturation point
Regulatory framework uncertainty in real estate
Outstanding liabilities to parties under CIRP and non-traceable parties
Unsecured interest-free loans without proper documentation
Loans granted in contravention of Section 186(7) of Companies Act, 2013
Employee benefit liabilities based on court orders/judgements
facts.related_party_note: Unsecured loans amounting to ₹3,51,189.88 Thousands obtained, represented as interest-free by management; outstanding liabilities of ₹75,899.55 Thousands payable to three parties (two under CIRP, one non-traceable); interest-free loans and advances granted including in contravention of Section 186(7) of Companies Act, 2013.
